allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Company on track to achieve project completion for its major Ghatkopar ProjectHubtown Limited ( Company ), a leading Mumbai based real estate developer had earlier announced the financial closure of its Rising City project, developed by its subsidiary, Rare Townships Private Limited (RTPL), located in Ghatkopar, through the investment of the SWAMIH Fund (Towers A1-A5) and Gopani Realty LLP (Tower A-6). Further, the Company had also successfully completed the rights issue in the subsidiary Rare Townships Private Limited, thereby increasing the Company s stake in the subsidiary RTPL to 72.22%.

allot.text: Pursuant to regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that Rare Townships Private Limited (RTPL), a Subsidiary Company, has today allotted 10705606 Class A equity shares of face value of Rs.10/- each at Par for cash for the total consideration of Rs.10,70,56,060/- to the Company.
